description: Returns, in one call, what the calling Jam Jam identity is allowed to do and how much of each allowance is left. THREE INDEPENDENT COUNTERS, they never borrow from one another: `conversion` (10 per week on a free account, 500 per calendar month on Premium, 3 per 24h anonymous), `read` (2000 per UTC day free, 20000 Premium, spent by the notebook and social listing tools) and `write` (200 per UTC day free, 5000 Premium, spent by the notebook writing tools). Stem separation and AI music detection keep their own counters, read with jj_stems_capabilities and jj_ai_music_availability. `scopes` lists the permissions of the API key in use. Call this before a batch, and after a quota error to learn when it resets. Costs nothing itself.
name: jj_check_usage
title: Check quotas and what this key may do
